welcome.title: Welcome to Macro
welcome.body: Macro is organized by modes. The best onboarding shows controls when they become useful, then lets the user take back control.
points: The left and right panels reopen when a step needs them.
You can restart it anytime from the book button at the top.

modes.title: Mode selector
modes.body: These three buttons change the whole workspace. Architect is for scoping, Implement is for executing, and Chat is for free-form discussion with context.
points: Implement: tasks, terminal, and change validation.
Chat: conversations, sources, and general tools.

panel-toggles.title: Side panels
panel-toggles.body: Panel buttons hide or show context areas. The left panel often contains the work list, while the right panel contains details or validation.

settings-and-help.title: Settings and onboarding
settings-and-help.body: Settings group AI providers, models, tool security, themes, and shortcuts. The book button next to it restarts this guide.

architect-mode.title: Architect mode
architect-mode.body: Architect turns a discussion into a strategy when the user explicitly asks for one.

architect-plan-selector.title: Plans
architect-plan-selector.body: The plan selector isolates conversations and strategies for each plan.

architect-generate.title: Generate the strategy
architect-generate.body: This action builds the task graph and predictable branches from the conversation and project context.

architect-strategy.title: Strategy and branches
architect-strategy.body: The right panel shows the strategy. The Graph / Branches switch helps move from a dependency view to a Git execution view.
points: Branches: work grouped by feature branch.
Expand opens a more comfortable explorer.

architect-validate.title: Validate the plan
architect-validate.body: Validation freezes the plan enough to provision branches and feed Implement. Started or completed tasks are protected from destructive regenerations.

implement-mode.title: Implement mode
implement-mode.body: Implement is for picking up a task, discussing execution, opening a terminal, and validating modified files before commit.

implement-tasks.title: Task queue
implement-tasks.body: The left panel sorts tasks by state. The plus creates an independent feature, and the archive button shows or hides older tasks.

implement-agent.title: Plan or Build
implement-agent.body: In Implement, this control chooses the agent behavior. Plan prepares or clarifies, while Build changes code and executes.

implement-terminal.title: Task terminal
implement-terminal.body: The terminal opens in the context of the selected task and project. If there are multiple projects, Macro can ask which one to target.

implement-changes.title: Change validation
implement-changes.body: The right panel tracks modified files by project. Validate stages accepted changes, Commit records what is ready, and Finish completes the task when everything is resolved.

chat-mode.title: Chat mode
chat-mode.body: Chat is the free-form mode. It keeps conversations separate from plans and tasks, while allowing files, links, tools, and sources.

chat-conversations.title: Conversations
chat-conversations.body: The left panel manages history: new chat, search, multi-select, pinning, archive, export, and delete.

chat-toolbox.title: Toolbox
chat-toolbox.body: The right panel is the context box. You can attach files, add a URL, paste text, enable tools, and find cited sources.

chat-models.title: Provider, model, and reasoning
chat-models.body: These menus choose the AI provider, model, and reasoning effort. If a button is disabled, you often need to configure a key in Settings.

composer.title: Compose and send
composer.body: The composer accepts text, mentions, and pasted images. The arrow button sends, or stops generation when a response is running.

footer.title: Git bar and notifications
footer.body: The bottom bar summarizes the group, branches, fetch / pull / push, and the notification center. Watch this area when Macro asks for a sync action.

done.title: Restartable onboarding
done.body: The tour is complete. The book button restarts this guide to revisit modes or explain a button to someone new.

fallback.title: Something needs attention
fallback.body: Macro could not complete this action safely.
fallback.nextStep: Review the details, fix the blocking state, then retry.

checkedOut.title: Macro could not prepare the task workspace
checkedOut.body: The branch needed for this task is still open in the main repository with local changes.
checkedOut.nextStep: Commit, stash, or discard those local changes, then retry the task.

missingBase.title: Macro could not find the base branch
missingBase.body: This task needs a base branch before its worktree can be created.
missingBase.nextStep: Create the branch or update the project Git workflow settings, then retry.

fallback.title: Macro could not prepare the task workspace
fallback.body: The task workspace is not ready yet, so Macro cannot safely review or edit files.
fallback.nextStep: Retry the task. If it still fails, open the project Git settings and check the repository state.

readOnly.title: This project is available for reading only
readOnly.body: This project can be used as context, but Macro cannot create branches, worktrees, commits, or merges there yet.
readOnly.namedBody: {{projectName}} can be used as context, but Macro cannot create branches, worktrees, commits, or merges there yet.
readOnly.missingGitNextStep: Initialize Git for this project, then enable editable work.
readOnly.settingsNextStep: Open project settings and make sure the Git workflow is ready.

missing.titleSingular: Plan metadata is missing in {{count}} repository
missing.titlePlural: Plan metadata is missing in {{count}} repositories
missing.body: Macro needs every expected plan metadata replica before it can safely update this plan.
missing.nextStep: Repair the plan metadata, then retry the action.

diverged.title: Plan metadata differs between repositories
diverged.body: Macro found more than one version of this plan metadata and must choose a canonical copy before continuing.
diverged.nextStep: Repair from the newest replica unless you intentionally need an older copy.

repositoryDirty.title: Repository has local changes
repositoryDirty.body: Macro cannot finish this merge while the target repository has unrelated uncommitted changes.
repositoryDirty.nextStep: Commit, stash, or discard the local changes, then retry the merge.

mergeInProgress.title: A merge is already in progress
mergeInProgress.body: Macro found an unfinished merge in this repository.
mergeInProgress.nextStep: Finish or abort the existing merge, then retry.

conflict.title: Resolve these conflicts before finishing
conflict.body: The plan cannot be merged cleanly yet.
conflict.filesNextStep: Resolve the listed files, then retry the merge.
conflict.blockersNextStep: Resolve the merge blockers, then retry.

dirty.title: @macro metadata has local changes
dirty.body: Macro needs to save metadata changes before syncing.
dirty.nextStep: Save @macro metadata, then retry the sync.

ahead.title: @macro metadata is ready to publish
ahead.body: Your local metadata branch has changes that are not on the remote yet.

behind.title: @macro metadata is behind remote
behind.body: Remote metadata has updates that are not local yet.

diverged.title: @macro metadata has diverged
diverged.body: Local and remote metadata both changed.
diverged.nextStep: Pull @macro, resolve any conflicts, then push.

mergeConflict.title: @macro metadata has conflicts
mergeConflict.body: The metadata branch has unresolved conflict files.
mergeConflict.nextStep: Resolve the conflicted metadata files, then retry the same sync step.

missingOrigin.title: @macro remote is not configured
missingOrigin.body: Macro cannot sync metadata because the repository has no origin remote.
missingOrigin.nextStep: Configure the Git remote, then retry.

missingUpstream.title: @macro has no upstream branch
missingUpstream.body: The metadata branch exists locally but is not linked to a remote branch yet.
missingUpstream.nextStep: Push @macro to publish it, or ignore this warning to keep metadata local.

authRequired.title: Git authentication is required
authRequired.body: Macro cannot reach the metadata remote with the current credentials.

networkError.title: Metadata sync could not reach the remote
networkError.body: The network or remote service is unavailable right now.

unknownError.title: Macro metadata sync failed
unknownError.body: Macro could not complete the metadata sync safely.
unknownError.nextStep: Retry the sync. If it fails again, inspect the technical details.

resourcePressure.title: Macro is temporarily overloaded
resourcePressure.body: The system has too many files open, so Macro paused automatic repository refreshes before retrying.
resourcePressure.nextStep: Wait a moment, then retry. If this keeps happening, close extra project windows or terminals.

replicaRepair.title: Plan metadata needs repair
replicaRepair.body: Macro found inconsistent plan metadata and needs to repair the canonical copy before continuing.
replicaRepair.nextStep: Repair the plan metadata, then retry the action.

metadataMissing.title: Plan metadata is incomplete
metadataMissing.body: Macro found a task or conversation that points to plan metadata that is missing or only partially persisted.
metadataMissing.nextStep: Repair the metadata links, then retry the action.

workspaceUnavailable.title: Workspace state is temporarily unavailable
workspaceUnavailable.body: Macro could not read the workspace state needed for this action.
workspaceUnavailable.nextStep: Retry after the workspace finishes updating. If it persists, reopen the project.

gitNotReady.title: This project is not ready for editable work
gitNotReady.body: Macro can still use this project for context, but it cannot write to it until Git is ready.
gitNotReady.nextStep: Open project settings and finish the Git setup.

fallback.title: Something needs attention
fallback.nextStep: Review the details, fix the blocking state, then retry.
